creator: nocode.joshua
title: Five free Google AI tools: AI Studio, Stitch, Opal, Antigravity and Flow

tools.name: Google AI Studio
tools.detail: Prompt-to-app/website builder; screen shows 'Build your ideas with Gemini' prompt box

tools.name: Google Stitch
tools.detail: Generates full UI designs for apps/websites, exportable to code

tools.name: Google Opal
tools.detail: Described as Google's free Zapier alternative; describe a workflow and an agent builds the automation (node canvas shown)

tools.name: Google Antigravity
tools.detail: Described as Google's 'agnostic' (agentic) coding IDE that works across all projects

tools.name: Google Flow
tools.detail: Studio for AI video, image and music generation

tools.name: GPT-6 Astra
tools.detail: Mentioned as the hyped competitor; logo shown in diagram

claims: Google 'silently released' five AI tools and all are completely free
AI Studio lets you create a shareable app or website within minutes from a prompt
Stitch exports UI designs straight into code
Opal is a free Zapier alternative where an agent builds the whole automation
Antigravity works across all your projects
Flow is powered by Google's best models
how_to_steps: Comment 'Google' to get the full list
on_screen_only: Infographic 'Google AI Ecosystem' with cards labelled Stitch, Opal, Antigravity, Google AI Studio, Google Flow; first frame shows a GPT 6 Astra logo instead

Cards labelled 'TOOL 04 GOOGLE AI STUDIO: Bring an idea to life with a prompt and create a shareable app or website in minutes', 'TOOL 01 STITCH: Build full UI designs for apps or websites, then export them into code', 'TOOL 05 GOOGLE FLOW: A complete studio for AI video, image and music generation'

Gemini screen: 'Build your ideas with Gemini' with example prompt 'Build me a web app for tracking personal fitness goals with real-time analytics and data visualization' and chips 'Google Keep', 'Google Meet'
Stitch output: landing page 'Studio Alpha - Organic handcrafted' with headline 'Crafting Atmospheres for the Modern Brand' and 'Featured Works'
Opal: node-based workflow canvas; Antigravity: 'AI Coding Agent' diagram with API/mobile/web nodes; Flow: video editor timeline with 'Add to Prompt' button

relevance.why: Stitch (UI design to code) and Antigravity (agentic IDE) overlap with a Claude Code founder's workflow; AI Studio/Opal/Flow are adjacent. Free tier is attractive but the video is a listicle with no depth.

implement_score.why: Maybe try Stitch for quick UI mockups to feed Claude Code; Antigravity is a competitor IDE not worth switching to. Opal could replace Zapier for simple automations if it is truly free.

verify: Are Stitch, Opal, Antigravity and Flow all currently free with no quota limits (Flow video gen usually requires a paid Google AI plan)?
Is Antigravity 'agnostic' (model-agnostic) or did the creator mean 'agentic'?
Does Stitch export production-quality code or just HTML/Figma mockups?
